query FlxSite($lang: String, $frontend: ID) {
  flxSite(lang: $lang, frontend: $frontend) {
    name
    description
    url
    cmsUrl
    graphqlUrl
    language
    locale
    languages {
      code
      locale
      name
      hreflang
      path
      url
      isDefault
    }
    logo {
      url
      width
      height
      alt
    }
    logoOnDark {
      url
      width
      height
      alt
    }
    icon
    menus {
      ...FlxHeadlessMenuFields
    }
    palette {
      slug
      name
      color
    }
    contact {
      email
      phone
      whatsapp
      address
    }
    currencies {
      code
      symbol
      decimals
      decimalSeparator
      thousandSeparator
      position
      isDefault
    }
    legalPages {
      kind
      title
      path
      url
    }
    captcha {
      provider
      version
      siteKey
      scriptUrl
    }
    social
    sitemapUrl
    searchPath
    cacheTags
    frontendId
  }
}

fragment FlxHeadlessMenuFields on FlxHeadlessMenu {
  location
  name
  source
  items {
    id
    parentId
    label
    url
    path
    target
    external
    order
  }
}
